note: Recorded development/stress responses for deterministic policy regression. Not proof of model accuracy.

case.rationale: Owner alone can sustain a block on user withdrawals indefinitely.

legend.0: No power over others' assets; no financial effect or only fully funded exercise of the caller's own entitlement.
legend.1: Limited economic influence with an explicit narrow bound; no seizure of shared reserves or unbacked claims.
legend.2: Material influence over shared economics, prices or asset disposition, with meaningful enforced limits.
legend.3: Can seize or redirect shared/user assets, mint unbacked redeemable claims, or remove meaningful financial limits.

legend.0: No authorization or code-control power; ordinary use under existing permissions.
legend.1: Delegates only the caller's own entitlement or changes a narrowly scoped individual permission.
legend.2: Can grant/revoke operational protocol roles or change a shared access policy within a fixed scope.
legend.3: Can replace implementation/trusted authority, grant root control, or execute arbitrary code with protocol authority.

legend.0: No meaningful ability to disrupt other users' operations or exits.
legend.1: Narrow individual disruption or a short enforced interruption without shared exit loss.
legend.2: Can interrupt shared operations, with an enforced duration limit or an independent restoring party shown.
legend.3: Can sustain a broad shutdown or prevent shared exits/recovery with no effective independent restoration bound shown.
